about: What the request roles anon and authenticated may still READ, WRITE or EXECUTE in schema public, and which storage policies and public buckets may exist, since migration 057 (default-deny, security audit SA-10 and the owner's scope extension of 2026-11-13). Read by .github/scripts/supabase_request_role_check.py (ci.yml::migrations-replay); 057's own self-check holds the same lists, and tests/test_supabase_057.py holds the two equal. An entry added after 057 must be granted by name in a later migration (the test checks that too). Reads are column grants: no request role holds a table-level privilege on any public table, and RLS still decides the rows of every read.

reads.why: hooks/useSupabaseTrainings.js: the direct read selects LIVE_COLUMNS (22 names, exported there) filtered on user_id / workgroup_id and ordered by requested_at; the Realtime channels trainings:user / trainings:group filter on user_id / workgroup_id and merge the delivered row (stripSecrets drops user_id, worker_token, cloud_job_id). So LIVE_COLUMNS plus user_id. Every other trainings column (training_params, cloud_job_id, log_url, managed, current_attempt, train_seconds_used, step_advanced_at, dataset_fps, unplaced_since, cancel_*) is read only through the cloud API.

hooks/useGroupDatasets.js: Realtime channels datasets:user / datasets:group (filters owner_user_id / workgroup_id; mergeRow sorts by updated_at and keeps the API row's other fields); its only consumer, components/DatasetSelector.js, reads id, hf_repo_id and name. The list itself comes from the cloud API's /datasets.

hooks/useSupabaseWorkflows.js: Realtime channels workflows:user / workflows:group (filters owner_user_id / workgroup_id; mergeWorkflow sorts by updated_at); its only consumer, components/Workshop/TemplatePicker.jsx, reads id, name, description, is_template and updated_at, and a pick passes only the id (WorkshopPage::handlePickWorkflow loads the document through the API).

hooks/useSupabaseTutorialProgress.js: the Realtime channel tutorial_progress:user (filter user_id) REPLACES the map entry with the delivered row, read by components/Workshop/SkillmapPlayer.jsx ({current_step, completed_at, updated_at}, keyed by tutorial_id): every column.

No client reads users. The read policies of trainings, datasets, workflows, tutorial_progress, workgroups and workgroup_memberships sub-select users.id, role, classroom_id and workgroup_id (pg_depend), and a policy's sub-select runs with the reader's privileges: without these columns every kept read fails with 42501. RLS ('Users read consolidated') still limits the rows to the own row, a teacher's classroom and an aal2 admin.

No client reads classrooms. The read policies of trainings, datasets, workflows, tutorial_progress, workgroups and workgroup_memberships sub-select classrooms.id and teacher_id (pg_depend). RLS still limits the rows.
No client reads workgroups. The read policies of datasets and workgroup_memberships sub-select workgroups.id and classroom_id (pg_depend). RLS still limits the rows.
No client reads workgroup_memberships. The read policies of trainings, datasets and workflows sub-select workgroup_memberships.user_id and workgroup_id (pg_depend). RLS still limits the rows.

functions.why: Called by the policies 'Users read consolidated' and 'Classrooms read consolidated' (pg_depend), and through them by every read policy whose sub-select reads users or classrooms; a policy runs as the reader, and only authenticated reads a table (anon reads none since 057), Realtime's postgres_changes included. Migration 056 makes it require aal2; its body is 056's.
Called by the policy 'Users read consolidated' (pg_depend), evaluated for every users read, the sub-selects of the other read policies included (authenticated only: anon reads no table).
Called by the policy 'Classrooms read consolidated' (pg_depend) (authenticated only: anon reads no table).

The training worker's only database write: modal_training/training_handler.py::_call_progress_rpc calls it with the anon key and the per-attempt worker token (legacy and managed mode, Modal and the RunPod trainer image). Granted to anon and authenticated since migration 010/032 (CLAUDE.md Rule 4); authenticated has no caller in this repository and is kept as that grant stood. Worker-token gated.
modal_inference/session_backend.py::SupabaseSessionBackend._rpc with the anon key (migration 048); token hash and Modal session id gated.
